title: Binding of single/double stranded ct-DNA with graphene oxide‑silver nanocomposites in vitro: A multispectroscopic approach.
authors: Xu, Xiangyu; Pan, Hongshuo; Li, Wenbo; Xu, Jiayi; Chen, Xinyun; Zheng, Chuanqi; Peng, Jia; Mao, Xuyan; Liu, Min; Yan, Hui; Wang, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验和分子对接研究单/双链DNA与氧化石墨烯-银纳米复合物的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但对象为纳米材料而非转录因子，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与课题核心TF-DNA建模关联较弱。
abstract: The fundamental binding of single-stranded (ssDNA) and double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) with graphene oxide-Ag nanocomposites (GO-AgNCPs) has been systematically investigated by multi spectroscopic methods, i.e. ultraviolet-visible (UV-vis) absorption, fluorescence spectroscopy, and circular dichroism (CD). The experimental and theoretical results demonstrate that both ssDNA and dsDNA can be adsorbed onto the GO-AgNCPs surface. All of the evidence indicated that there were relatively strong binding of ssDNA/dsDNA with GO-AgNCPs. The article compares the differences in binding between the two types of DNA and the nanomaterials using spectroscopic and thermodynamic data. UV-vis absorption spectroscopy experiments indicate that the characteristic absorbance intensity of both ss DNA and ds DNA increases, but the rate of change in absorbance is different. The fluorescence results revealed that ss/dsDNA could interact with the GO-AgNCPs surface, in spite of the different binding affinities. The K(a) value of ssDNA binding with GO-AgNCPs is greater than that of dsDNA at each constant temperature, indicating that the affinity of dsDNA toward GO-AgNCPs is comparatively weak. Molecular docking studies have corroborated the mentioned experimental results. The calculated thermodynamic parameters showed that the binding process was thermodynamically spontaneous, van der Waals force and hydrogen bonding played predominant roles in the binding process. The mechanism of ss/ds DNA binding with GO-AgNCPs was also investigated, and the results indicated that GO-AgNCPs directly binds to the minor groove of ss/ds DNA by replacing minor groove binders.
abstract_zh: 已通过多种光谱方法，即紫外-可见（UV-vis）吸收光谱、荧光光谱和圆二色（CD）光谱，系统研究了单链DNA（ssDNA）和双链DNA（dsDNA）与氧化石墨烯-银纳米复合材料（GO-AgNCPs）的基本结合行为。实验和理论结果表明，ssDNA和dsDNA均可吸附到GO-AgNCPs表面。所有证据表明，ssDNA/dsDNA与GO-AgNCPs之间存在相对较强的结合。本文利用光谱和热力学数据比较了两种类型DNA与纳米材料之间结合的差异。紫外-可见吸收光谱实验表明，ssDNA和dsDNA的特征吸收强度均增加，但吸光度变化速率不同。荧光结果显示，尽管结合亲和力不同，ss/dsDNA仍能与GO-AgNCPs表面相互作用。在每个恒定温度下，ssDNA与GO-AgNCPs结合的K(a)值均大于dsDNA，表明dsDNA对GO-AgNCPs的亲和力相对较弱。分子对接研究证实了上述实验结果。计算的热力学参数表明，结合过程在热力学上是自发的，范德华力和氢键在结合过程中起主导作用。还研究了ss/dsDNA与GO-AgNCPs结合的机制，结果表明GO-AgNCPs通过替换小沟结合剂，直接结合到ss/dsDNA的小沟中。
